TITLE: Single image
DESCRIPTION: Original test shader written for Strobe's fixtures. MIT, like the repository.

CONTROLS.NAME: st_speed
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How fast iTime runs. 1 is real time.

CONTROLS.NAME: st_audio_time
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Blend iTime's pace toward the bass: slow when quiet, surging on loud bass.

CONTROLS.NAME: st_zoom
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Zoom of the picture around its centre.

CONTROLS.NAME: st_hue
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Hue rotation of the picture, degrees.
